answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each claim is checked by 3 auditors, each staking 20 credits. A timber claim needs receipt checks. Timber from a grove must match its harvest record; via an inlet it must match the port log. Approving a fake forfeits auditors' stakes and burns the faker's 50-credit bond. With 1,000 fakes, a 10% audit hit burns 100 bonds (5,000 credits), while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its reward undiluted.
